name: Abjurant Crusade (Imperial Origin)
body:
You are from a land of magic-wielding knights whose mastery of abjuration has been put to good use protecting its citizens and allies.

Imperial Training: tornsword

Overloaded Mark: The target of your overloaded mark takes a penalty to damage rolls equal to 1/3 your emissary level while the mark is active (minimum -1). Additionally, the first time the target attacks while the mark is active, they must roll twice and take the worse result.

Imperial Origin Abilities
Crusader’s Aegis (Sp)

At 1st level, you grant yourself the benefit of the shield spell for 1 minute as a standard action, however, while it is active you cannot use any other imperial origin abilities. You can dismiss this shield as a free action. This ability is usable at will.

Chivalric Ward (Su)

At 7th level, you can place a ward upon your allies for 10 minutes per emissary level. You grant the benefits of shield other on a number of allies equal to your Charisma modifier. This ability is usable once per day plus an additional time at 13th and 19th levels.

Vital Shield (Sp)

At 14th level, you can cast aid as a spell-like ability using your emissary level as your caster level.

This spell-like ability may be cast at will but cannot be cast upon yourself.
